title: File:(Markets of Port Vila, Vanuatu) - DPLA - a9cada4c70da5571f52147663e40e67b.jpg
description: Photograph of the public market in Port Vila on Efate Island, Vanuatu. Women sit among the fruits, vegetables, plants and plant leaves, and flowers they sell at the market. In the background, many shoppers are visible walking amongst the vendors. A sign, "Boucherie du Marche" (market butcher), is painted on the side of a red-colored building in the background. 1 photograph : positive, col. ; 35 mm.
